# Why did my Google Contacts import fail?

> Free Google Contacts CSV checker: finds headings Google skips, emails and phone numbers that will not import, impossible birthdays, blank and duplicate rows and Excel damage, with line numbers, applies safe fixes and splits big files. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
